title: Windows Hub cannot invoke codex.cmd or register auto-update
original_report: Hobbyka Hub 0.4.36 fails to install a plugin through codex.cmd, then exceeds the 261-character schtasks /TR limit while enabling auto-update.
expected: Windows invokes the Codex cmd shim, registers the plugin, creates the 15-minute auto-update task and exits successfully.
actual: cmd.exe preserved an extra outer quote pair around codex.cmd, and the PowerShell EncodedCommand used for /TR exceeded 261 characters.
environment: Reported on Windows, Node.js 24.19.0, Codex Desktop 26.814.5517.0, codex-cli 0.148.0-alpha.15, Hobbyka Hub 0.4.36; regression executed with Node.js test runner on macOS.
reproduction: The focused test evaluates the real command builders and captures the exact cmd.exe argv, schtasks dispatch decision and /TR action.
failure_signal: Before the fix, cmd.exe received double outer quotes, schtasks was routed through cmd.exe and the generated EncodedCommand was longer than the supported task action.
root_cause: The shared Windows process wrapper added an outer quote pair after already quoting every cmd argument. It also treated schtasks.exe as a shell script, which forced its internally quoted /TR action through the restrictive command builder; the previous workaround expanded that action into a long UTF-16 Base64 PowerShell command.
fix_summary: Keep cmd.exe only for .cmd/.bat shims without the redundant outer pair; run schtasks.exe directly; use the existing hidden VBS launcher as the short task action.
why_causal: The same three assertions now observe the argv and /TR forms required by the failing Windows tools, while unsafe cmd metacharacters remain rejected.

reproduction_files.summary: Focused Windows command and scheduler regression.

fix_files.summary: Minimal Windows process and task action correction.

checks.name: Focused regression
checks.detail: The same test changed from 3 failures to 3 passes.

limitations: Real Windows acceptance is required after publishing 0.4.37.
notes: No dependency or public command syntax changed.
